report:
### methodology-390 (390px)
1. **HeaderBar mobile state** — Preview renders an exposed “vendors” search input and “sign up” pill in the header. Design shows the collapsed mobile header with only the hamburger menu. The responsive breakpoint that toggles the mobile header is firing too late (or not at all) at 390px.
2. **Standards table overflow** — The preview table is squished and the rightmost columns (LABELING, SOMETIMES) are clipped. Design implies a horizontally scrollable table or reflowed cards on mobile so all five columns remain readable.
3. **Card surface colors missing** — Policy cards under “What Vendors Can and Cannot Change,” the four “How the Labeling Score Works” items, formula cards, and rating cards all appear as white/border-only in the preview. Design shows each card with a subtle light-gray/off-white background fill that separates it from the page background.
4. **Labeling Score Works badge color** — Item 4 (“Website-only claims”) uses a dark gray/black circular badge. Design uses the same green badge as items 1–3.
5. **Section vertical rhythm** — The whitespace between major sections (e.g., Standards → Labeling → Rating Percent) is visibly tighter in the preview than in the design.
6. **Footer link density** — Footer links are stacked more tightly in the preview; design shows slightly looser inter-item spacing.

### methodology-744 (744px)
1. **HeaderBar extra button** — Preview shows a “vendors” button next to “sign up.” Design shows only the “sign up” pill in the header at this width.
2. **Methodology two-column ratio** — The Analysts and Vendors columns appear close to 50/50. Design gives the Analysts column roughly 40% width and the Vendors/policy column roughly 60% width.
3. **Policy card styling** — Policy cards lack the light background fill seen in the design and rely only on borders, making them visually flat.
4. **Labeling Score Works grid** — The 2×2 grid cards have uneven heights in the preview because text wrapping differs per card. Design shows uniform row heights.
5. **Labeling Score Calculated alignment** — The left column (“If only a label claim is present”) and right column (“If both…”) are not top-aligned; the left column sits higher. Design shows both sections starting on the same horizontal line.
6. **Formula card alignment** — Formula text is left-aligned and smaller than in the design, which presents formulas in a larger, centered/math-style treatment. Cards in the grid also have uneven heights.

### methodology-1440 (1440px)
1. **Hero heading typography** — The “Methodology” heading appears smaller in the preview than in the design (design uses a larger display size, roughly 48–56px, while preview looks closer to 36–40px).
2. **Methodology section column ratio & padding** — Left column (Analysts) is too narrow and the right column policy cards have excessive internal vertical padding, making the overall section taller than the design.
3. **Standards table cell padding** — Vertical padding inside table cells is too tight in the preview. Design uses more generous padding (roughly 16–20px vertical), giving the table breathing room.
4. **Labeling Score Works card 4 badge** — Same as mobile/tablet: the fourth badge is gray instead of green.
5. **Labeling Score Calculated layout** — Left and right sections are not top-aligned. The methodology note box has different vertical spacing, and the right-side “Batch identifier” / “Batch claim communication” blocks lack the light background/border styling shown in the design.
6. **Natural Rating vs Final Rating cards** — Three cards have uneven heights in the preview. Design shows equal-height cards with consistent internal padding and a subtle background fill.
7. **Formulas grid** — Cards lack the light background fill. Formula typography is too small and left-aligned; design uses a larger, centered presentation. Row heights are uneven across the 3×2 grid.
8. **How to Read the Final Rating cards** — Cards lack light backgrounds and have less internal padding than the design. The 50% badge appears darker/more muted.
9. **Leaderboard card** — “Bad results stay visible” card is missing the left-border accent and/or light background visible in the design.
